lessonPlan.title: Linear Zero-Bloat Quickstart: From Overwhelmed to Flow State
lessonPlan.subtitle: Set up a clean, high-velocity backlog without losing your sanity in complex sprint configuration.
lessonPlan.overview: Traditional project trackers force you into bureaucratic workflows with hundreds of unneeded fields. In this 5-step lesson plan, you will configure Linear to be your team's distraction-free single source of truth.
prerequisites: A free Linear account
A list of 3-5 current backlog priorities to test with

steps.title: Account Initialization & Workspace Cleansing
steps.description: Sign in with your team or personal email. Skip the bloated enterprise questionnaire and choose the Minimalist Engineering preset.
actionItems: Select 'Software Development' as your team focus to auto-hide unnecessary enterprise metadata.
Choose your team identifier prefix (e.g., 'DEV' or 'APP').
Turn on Dark Mode (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + D) for reduced eye strain.
steps.proTip: Linear stores its state locally first. You can perform every operation offline without worrying about server lag.

steps.title: Master the Command Palette (The 'K' Habit)
steps.description: Stop reaching for your mouse. Linear is engineered around keyboard commands that keep you in flow state.
actionItems: Press 'C' anywhere in the application to summon the instant issue composer.
Press 'Cmd + K' (Mac) or 'Ctrl + K' (Windows) to open the Command Palette.
Create your first issue: Type 'Fix navigation contrast' and press Cmd+Enter.
steps.proTip: Tap '?' at any time to inspect the full interactive keyboard cheat sheet overlay.

steps.title: Configuring Anti-Bloat Cycles (Sprints Without Overhead)
steps.description: Replace cumbersome sprint planning ceremonies with automated, auto-rolling cycles.
actionItems: Navigate to Team Settings > Cycles.
Toggle 'Enable Cycles' with a 2-week rolling window.
Enable 'Auto-archive completed issues after 30 days' to keep backlogs razor-sharp.
steps.proTip: Never maintain a 500-ticket backlog. If an issue isn't tackled within 3 cycles, use Linear's Auto-Close rule.

steps.title: Filtering & Custom Clean Views
steps.description: Build a single distraction-free view that shows only what demands your immediate attention today.
actionItems: Press 'V' to open View Options.
Filter by: Assignee = 'Me', Status = 'In Progress' or 'Todo'.
Save this view as 'My Daily Focus' and pin it to your sidebar.
steps.proTip: Hide estimations and complexity points if your team ships continuously—it removes 80% of ticket friction.

steps.title: GitHub/GitLab Zero-Click Auto-Closing
steps.description: Connect your version control so closing PRs automatically marks tickets resolved without manual status dragging.
actionItems: Go to Settings > Integrations > GitHub.
Authorize the repository and link branch names to issue IDs.
Commit with 'Fixes DEV-14' to auto-move issues to Done on merge.
steps.proTip: You will never have to manually log in to Jira or Linear just to drag a card to 'Completed' again.

tools.tagline: Open-source, lightning-fast screen recording without Loom's paywalls.
tools.replacesDetailed: Replaces Loom's 5-minute free limits, forced cloud processing delays, and heavy browser extension memory leaks with instant native recording and sharable links.
tools.targetAudience: Remote team leads, indie builders, software engineers, and educators who need frictionless video communication.

learningCurve.summary: Zero configuration. Click record or hit a global hotkey, talk, and get an instant shareable link.

tools.affiliatePerk: Unlimited recordings with self-hosting or free cloud tier

lessonPlan.title: Cap Express Lesson: High-Def Screen Recordings Without the Bloat
lessonPlan.subtitle: Record, annotate, and share your screen in under 60 seconds with zero subscription anxiety.
lessonPlan.overview: Cloud screen recording tools have become bloated with mandatory enterprise workspaces, AI upsells, and 5-minute limits. Cap brings screen recording back to what it should be: fast, private, and lightweight.
prerequisites: Cap installed on macOS or Windows (or browser app)
Microphone & optional webcam

steps.title: Clean Installation & Permission Grant
steps.description: Download Cap and grant screen and microphone permissions with one prompt.
actionItems: Launch Cap and allow Screen Recording & Microphone permissions.
Choose your default audio input (built-in mic or USB microphone).
Enable 'Save locally by default' for instant offline availability.
steps.proTip: Unlike web extensions that crash when you close the tab, native Cap records smoothly even under high CPU load.

steps.title: Setting Up Global Instant Hotkeys
steps.description: Configure a single key combination to start recording from any window instantly.
actionItems: Open Cap Preferences (Cmd/Ctrl + ,).
Set 'Quick Record Region' to Cmd+Shift+R.
Set 'Instant Fullscreen Record' to Cmd+Shift+F.
steps.proTip: Pressing the hotkey gives you a non-intrusive 3-second countdown with sound cue.

steps.title: Recording with Crisp Auto-Zoom & Camera Bubble
steps.description: Create professional presentations without manual video editing.
actionItems: Select your display area or specific application window.
Toggle the circular camera overlay and drag it to any corner.
Use the drawing pencil shortcut to circle UI elements during capture.
steps.proTip: Cap features automatic smooth cursor smoothing so jittery mouse movements look polished.

steps.title: Trimming the Fluff with Zero Re-encoding
steps.description: Cut out dead air at the beginning and end in seconds without waiting for cloud re-rendering.
actionItems: When stopping the recording, drag the left and right trim handles.
Preview the trimmed segment instantly in real-time.
Click 'Done' to finalize cuts without CPU encoding lag.
steps.proTip: Trimming uses direct stream copying, completing in under 200 milliseconds.

steps.title: One-Click Instant Sharing or MP4 Export
steps.description: Get a clean, unbranded link or high-bitrate MP4 copied to your clipboard.
actionItems: Click 'Copy Link' for instant cloud sharing (no ads or registration required for viewers).
Or click 'Save MP4' for raw 60fps local storage.
steps.proTip: You can connect your own Amazon S3 or Cloudflare R2 bucket for 100% self-hosted ownership.

lessonPlan.title: Dub.co Onboarding: From Bloated URLs to Lightning Branded Links
lessonPlan.subtitle: Connect your custom domain, generate UTM tracking links, and inspect edge analytics in 5 steps.
lessonPlan.overview: Legacy link shorteners hold your brand hostage behind expensive enterprise tiers. Dub provides a distraction-free, privacy-preserving link engine powered by Next.js and Edge Middleware.
prerequisites: A Dub.co account (free)
A custom domain (or use free dub.sh subdomains)

steps.title: Custom Domain DNS Setup
steps.description: Point your branded subdomain (e.g. go.yourbrand.com) to Dub's global edge network.
actionItems: In Dub settings, click 'Add Domain' and input your subdomain.
Add a CNAME record in Cloudflare/Namecheap pointing to 'cname.dub.co'.
Automatic SSL certificates will generate within 60 seconds.
steps.proTip: Using Cloudflare DNS? Set the proxy status to 'DNS Only' (grey cloud) for fastest verification.

steps.title: Creating Your First Smart Short Link
steps.description: Generate a custom slug with automatic open-graph preview scraping.
actionItems: Hit 'Cmd + N' or click 'Create Link'.
Paste your target destination URL.
Set a memorable slug (e.g., /launch or /guide).
Dub will auto-fetch the target title, favicon, and preview card.
steps.proTip: Enable 'Random Slug Generator' if you need high-volume short links for programmatic usage.

steps.title: Frictionless UTM Campaign Tagging
steps.description: Add campaign, source, and medium parameters without ugly manual URL strings.
actionItems: Expand the 'UTM Builder' accordion inside the link modal.
Fill in Source (e.g. twitter), Medium (social), and Campaign (november-drop).
Notice how Dub neatly encapsulates all tracking behind the clean short slug.
steps.proTip: Save UTM templates to reuse your standard campaign names across team members.

steps.title: Geo-Targeting & Device Rules (Without Enterprise Bloat)
steps.description: Route iOS users to the App Store and Android users to Google Play with one link.
actionItems: Toggle 'Targeting Rules' in the link settings.
Add iOS Rule -> Destination: App Store URL.
Add Android Rule -> Destination: Play Store URL.
Fallback destination: Web Landing Page.
steps.proTip: Bitly charges over $199/month for mobile deep-linking; Dub includes it natively.

steps.title: Privacy-Friendly Real-Time Analytics Inspection
steps.description: Review referrers, country breakdowns, and conversion clicks without invasive cookie trackers.
actionItems: Open your link dashboard to see real-time click heatmaps.
Filter by date range, country, or referring domain.
Export data to CSV or connect to Webhooks for automated Slack alerts.
steps.proTip: All analytics are GDPR-compliant out of the box with zero third-party cookie banners needed.

lessonPlan.title: Obsidian De-Bloated: Building an Eternal Second Brain in Markdown
lessonPlan.subtitle: Say goodbye to cloud lag. Organize your notes with bi-directional links and pure plain text.
lessonPlan.overview: Notion is great until your database hits 5,000 records and every click takes 4 seconds. Obsidian operates directly on local `.md` files on your hard drive, guaranteeing that your notes will remain readable 50 years from now.
prerequisites: Obsidian installed on your desktop or phone
A folder on your computer designated as your 'Vault'

steps.title: Creating Your First Local Vault
steps.description: Initialize your note vault in a local directory (e.g. iCloud, Dropbox, or local SSD).
actionItems: Open Obsidian and click 'Create new vault'.
Name it (e.g., 'CoreVault') and select a folder path on your drive.
Verify that notes created are simple `.md` files viewable in any text editor.
steps.proTip: Avoid putting your vault in deeply nested subfolders. A simple `/Documents/Notes` folder is ideal.

steps.title: Bi-Directional Wiki-Linking (`[[Note Name]]`)
steps.description: Ditch rigid folder hierarchies in favor of natural networked thoughts.
actionItems: Type `[[Project Alpha]]` inside any note to create an instant backlink.
Click on the newly created link to auto-generate the destination page.
Open the 'Backlinks' panel on the right sidebar to see all references connecting back.
steps.proTip: Use aliases by typing `[[Project Alpha|Alpha]]` to display natural phrasing while linking to the core document.

steps.title: The Interactive Graph View
steps.description: Visualize how your thoughts, research, and projects interconnect in 2D space.
actionItems: Press 'Cmd/Ctrl + G' to open Graph View.
Use the color groups feature to highlight tags (e.g. #active = green, #archive = gray).
Adjust node repulsion and gravity for a balanced celestial view of your knowledge.
steps.proTip: Don't stress over making the graph look pretty early on; focus on writing, and the web will grow organically.

steps.title: Anti-Bloat Plugin Selection (Keep It Lean)
steps.description: Avoid plugin hoard syndrome. Install only the 3 essential community tools.
actionItems: Settings > Community Plugins > Turn on Community Plugins.
Install 'Dataview' for lightweight SQL-like queries over your notes.
Install 'Omnisearch' for lightning-fast fuzzy text and PDF search.
Skip cosmetic widgets that slow down startup time.
steps.proTip: Check 'Debug Startup Time' in Settings to ensure total vault boot remains under 300ms.

steps.title: Free Multi-Device Sync Options
steps.description: Keep notes synced across laptop and mobile without paying high monthly subscriptions.
actionItems: Option A: Sync via standard iCloud Drive or Google Drive / Syncthing.
Option B: Use the Git plugin to auto-push notes to a private GitHub repo.
Option C: Support the developers with official end-to-end encrypted Obsidian Sync.
steps.proTip: Because files are raw text, merge conflicts can be resolved using standard git diff tools.

tools.name: Typora
tools.logoSvg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="18" y="18" width="64" height="64" rx="12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M32 36H68M50 36V66" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
tools.tagline: A truly distraction-free Markdown reader and editor with live seamless preview.
tools.replacesDetailed: Replaces Word's endless ribbon menus, formatting corruptions, slow startup times, and heavy .docx file bloat with a tranquil, pure writing canvas.
tools.targetAudience: Novelists, technical bloggers, academic researchers, and essayists who want words and typography to take center stage.

learningCurve.summary: Type markdown symbols and they immediately render into beautiful typography inline. Zero split-screen dissonance.

lessonPlan.title: Typora Mastery: Flow-State Writing Without Formatting Frustrations
lessonPlan.subtitle: Master inline live-rendering, mathematical formulas, and flawless PDF/HTML exports.
lessonPlan.overview: Word processors clutter your screen with 500 toolbar buttons you will never press. Typora eliminates split preview panes by rendering Markdown as you type, giving you pure typographic zen.
prerequisites: Typora installed on Windows, Mac, or Linux
A blank canvas ready to write

steps.title: The Live Preview Experience
steps.description: Learn how Typora collapses markdown syntax into formatted text instantly.
actionItems: Type `# Headline 1` and press Space or Enter to see it transform instantly.
Type `**bold text**` and `*italic text*` to witness inline rendering.
Click on any rendered word to reveal the underlying Markdown code for surgical edits.
steps.proTip: Press 'Ctrl + /' (or Cmd + /) to toggle raw source code mode whenever you want to inspect plain text.

steps.title: Focus Mode & Typewriter Scrolling
steps.description: Keep your current active sentence centered on screen to avoid neck strain.
actionItems: View > Toggle 'Typewriter Mode' (keeps current line pinned at vertical center).
View > Toggle 'Focus Mode' (dims all other paragraphs except the active sentence).
Press F11 / Cmd+Ctrl+F for Fullscreen borderless writing.
steps.proTip: Pair Focus Mode with ambient background noise for deep 90-minute writing sprints.

steps.title: Mathematical Formulas & Code Fences
steps.description: Write KaTeX formulas and syntax-highlighted code blocks effortlessly.
actionItems: Type `$$` and press Enter to open KaTeX display math block.
Type `\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2` to preview crisp vector mathematics.
Type ````javascript` to create a live highlighted code container.
steps.proTip: Typora supports Mermaid diagrams natively: type ````mermaid` to render instant flowcharts.

steps.title: Minimalist Themes & Custom CSS
steps.description: Choose high-readability typographic themes suited for print and digital reading.
actionItems: Themes menu > Switch between 'Github', 'Newsprint', and 'Night'.
Open theme folder to inject custom Google Fonts or CSS font smoothing rules.
steps.proTip: The 'Newsprint' theme is calibrated with optimal line heights for long-form non-fiction.

steps.title: Flawless PDF & Docx Export
steps.description: Export clean client-ready PDFs with custom headers, page numbering, and table of contents.
actionItems: File > Export > PDF.
Set page margins to 20mm and check 'Generate Table of Contents'.
Notice how typography matches professional book printing standards.
steps.proTip: Install Pandoc to enable one-click export into EPUB, Word, and LaTeX.

tools.name: Penpot
tools.logoSvg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M25 75L75 25M25 75L40 75L75 40M25 75L25 60L60 25" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="75" cy="25" r="8" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
tools.tagline: The open-source, web-standard design & prototyping tool for teams.
tools.replacesDetailed: Replaces Figma's closed ecosystem, developer handoff paywalls, expensive seat-tier pricing, and proprietary file formats with 100% native SVG and CSS Flexbox/Grid standards.
tools.targetAudience: UI/UX designers, front-end developers, open-source maintainers, and privacy-conscious design agencies.

learningCurve.summary: Familiar canvas layout for anyone who used Sketch or Figma, with developer-friendly CSS layout models.

tools.pricing: 100% Free Cloud & Self-Hostable, Team tiers available
tools.affiliatePerk: Unlimited projects & seats on open-source community edition

lessonPlan.title: Penpot Starter Kit: Designing with True Web Standards
lessonPlan.subtitle: Learn native SVG layouts, Flexbox/CSS Grid alignment, and developer handoff without proprietary lock-in.
lessonPlan.overview: Traditional design software disconnects designers from real web layout engines. Penpot is built from the ground up on native SVG and real CSS Flexbox and Grid, making developer handoff instant and exact.
prerequisites: A free Penpot cloud account or local Docker instance
Basic understanding of components and frames

steps.title: Board Creation & Standard Viewport Setup
steps.description: Initialize a responsive artboard with standard modern breakpoints.
actionItems: Click '+' to create a new file.
Press 'B' (Board tool) and select 'Desktop - 1440px' or 'Mobile - 390px'.
Enable the 8pt layout grid in the right design inspector.
steps.proTip: Penpot files are natively saved as SVG vectors, meaning you can open assets directly in Illustrator or browser.

steps.title: Flexbox Auto-Layout Like Real Code
steps.description: Harness real CSS Flexbox properties directly on the design canvas.
actionItems: Select multiple buttons or cards and press 'Shift + A' to add Auto Layout.
Switch between Row (horizontal) and Column (vertical) flow.
Tweak Gap, Padding, and Alignment (center, space-between, stretch).
steps.proTip: Unlike other tools that approximate auto-layout, Penpot outputs exact `display: flex` CSS rules.

steps.title: True CSS Grid Containers
steps.description: Build 12-column responsive dashboard layouts with genuine two-dimensional grid tracks.
actionItems: Create a container board and toggle Layout to 'CSS Grid'.
Define columns: `repeat(12, 1fr)` and gap: `16px`.
Drag UI cards into cells; notice how they snap according to grid areas.
steps.proTip: Penpot is the first major design tool in the world with full CSS Grid engine support.

steps.title: Design Tokens & Reusable Components
steps.description: Create design system components with shared color palettes and typography scales.
actionItems: Convert a primary button into a Main Component (Cmd/Ctrl + K).
Create instances across various boards to verify synchronized updates.
Link fills to Color Palette tokens for immediate dark-mode swapping.
steps.proTip: Tokens can be exported directly as JSON variables for Tailwind CSS or CSS Custom Properties.

steps.title: Zero-Paywall Developer Handoff
steps.description: Engineers can inspect, copy exact CSS, and download clean SVGs without paying for expensive 'editor seats'.
actionItems: Click the 'Code Inspect' tab in the top right.
Click any element to inspect computed CSS, markup, and SVG assets.
Copy ready-to-paste CSS Flex/Grid snippets straight into your codebase.
steps.proTip: Invite your entire engineering team as inspect viewers without incurring a single extra dollar in seat fees.

tools.name: Raycast
tools.logoSvg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M20 50L50 20L80 50L50 80L20 50Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8"/><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="10" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
tools.tagline: An extendable, blazingly fast launcher to replace bloated helper apps.
tools.whatItReplaces: Mac Spotlight, Alfred & 10 separate background apps
tools.replacesDetailed: Replaces slow Spotlight searches, bloated clipboard managers, separate window resizing tools, snippet expanders, and calculator widgets with a single lightweight executable.
tools.targetAudience: Mac developers, designers, writers, and power users who want maximum keyboard speed without memory drain.

learningCurve.summary: Works out of the box as an app launcher. Mastering extensions and window management takes minutes.

tools.pricing: 100% Free Core, optional Pro with AI and cloud sync
tools.affiliatePerk: Free forever core features + Pro trial

lessonPlan.title: Raycast Power-Hour: Consolidating 8 Apps into One Fast Launcher
lessonPlan.subtitle: Set up instant window management, clipboard history, text snippets, and API extensions.
lessonPlan.overview: Most computers run 5-10 small background utility apps that each consume 200MB of RAM and clutter menu bars. Raycast bundles these capabilities into one native, zero-latency binary.
prerequisites: Raycast installed on macOS (or Windows equivalent launcher like Flow/PowerToys)
Set Raycast shortcut to Cmd+Space

steps.title: Replacing Default Spotlight (Cmd + Space)
steps.description: Map your main search shortcut to Raycast and disable default Spotlight.
actionItems: Open Mac System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Spotlight.
Uncheck 'Show Spotlight search'.
In Raycast Settings, assign Raycast Hotkey to 'Cmd + Space'.
steps.proTip: Raycast launches in under 8ms with zero index caching delay.

steps.title: Infinite Clipboard History (Encrypted Locally)
steps.description: Never lose a copied snippet, link, hex code, or screenshot again.
actionItems: Trigger Raycast and type 'Clipboard History'.
Assign a direct alias shortcut (e.g., 'Cmd + Shift + V').
Search past copied items by text, image content, or color code.
steps.proTip: Set clipboard auto-clear to 7 days for maximum privacy and lean local database size.

steps.title: Zero-Lag Window Management
steps.description: Uninstall third-party window resizers like Magnet or Rectangle.
actionItems: Type 'Left Half', 'Right Half', 'Maximize', or 'Almost Maximize'.
Assign quick keybindings: Ctrl+Option+Left for Left Half, Ctrl+Option+Right for Right Half.
Tile two windows side by side in under 1 second without touching the mouse.
steps.proTip: Use 'First Third' and 'Last Two Thirds' for wide curved monitor setups.

steps.title: Dynamic Text Expander Snippets
steps.description: Stop repeatedly typing calendar links, zoom URLs, and repetitive email templates.
actionItems: Open 'Create Snippet' in Raycast.
Keyword: `!cal` -> Content: `https://cal.com/yourname`.
Keyword: `!zoom` -> Content: your personal meeting room link.
Type the keyword in any text field across the OS to auto-expand.
steps.proTip: Use dynamic placeholders like `{clipboard}` and `{date}` to automatically insert current values.

steps.title: Installing Verified Community Extensions
steps.description: Browse thousands of community plugins without installing separate desktop applications.
actionItems: Type 'Store' in Raycast.
Install 'GitHub' extension to search pull requests and issues instantly.
Install 'Brew' extension to search and update Homebrew packages in one click.
Install 'Color Picker' for instant hex sampling from your screen.
steps.proTip: All extensions run in isolated sandboxed workers so buggy plugins can never freeze your launcher.

tools.name: LosslessCut
tools.logoSvg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M20 30L45 55M20 70L45 45" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="20" cy="30" r="8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="6"/><circle cx="20" cy="70" r="8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="6"/><line x1="45" y1="50" x2="85" y2="50" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
tools.tagline: The Swiss Army knife of lossless video and audio trimming and slicing.
tools.whatItReplaces: Adobe Premiere & Final Cut for quick trims
tools.replacesDetailed: Replaces loading heavy 4GB video editors just to trim or extract a 30-second clip. Uses direct FFmpeg stream cutting with zero quality loss and instantaneous exports.
tools.targetAudience: Streamers, YouTubers, podcasters, drone videographers, and educators who need to cut video fast without re-encoding.

learningCurve.summary: Keyboard-driven in/out marker trimming. Export happens in under 2 seconds without CPU fan noise.

tools.pricing: 100% Free Open Source (GitHub) / Optional app store donation
tools.affiliatePerk: 100% free open-source software, zero render times

lessonPlan.title: LosslessCut Rapid Onboarding: Slice 4K Footage in Seconds
lessonPlan.subtitle: Extract video segments, merge clips, and remove audio tracks without re-encoding or generational loss.
lessonPlan.overview: Standard non-linear video editors re-encode your entire video just to clip off 5 seconds of silence, degrading quality and taking 15 minutes of CPU rendering. LosslessCut performs direct stream copying on the keyframe boundary in under 2 seconds.
prerequisites: LosslessCut installed on Windows, Mac, or Linux
A video file (.mp4, .mov, .mkv, .webm) to experiment with

steps.title: Drag & Drop File Ingestion
steps.description: Open any media file with instantaneous timeline playback.
actionItems: Drag your video directly into the LosslessCut window.
Observe that playback begins immediately with zero project indexing or scratch disk creation.
steps.proTip: LosslessCut handles massive 100GB 4K 120fps drone files without dropping a single frame.

steps.title: Setting In/Out Cut Points ('I' and 'O')
steps.description: Use standard video editing shortcuts to isolate your best segment.
actionItems: Scrub the timeline with J/K/L or the mouse cursor.
Press 'I' to set the Segment Start Point.
Press 'O' to set the Segment End Point.
Use Left/Right arrow keys for surgical frame-by-frame precision.
steps.proTip: Press ',' and '.' to jump strictly between keyframes (I-frames) for mathematically perfect clean cut points.

steps.title: Multi-Segment Batch Splitting
steps.description: Create multiple clips from one single source video in one pass.
actionItems: Click '+' or press 'N' to create a second segment.
Define new in and out points for highlight #2.
Label segments directly in the segment manager list.
steps.proTip: Choose between 'Export separate files' or 'Merge segments into one continuous file'.

steps.title: Stream Track Extraction & Audio Stripping
steps.description: Remove noisy microphone tracks or extract raw WAV/AAC audio from video.
actionItems: Click the 'Tracks' button on the bottom bar.
Toggle off Audio Track 2 if you only want the clean lavalier mic.
Click 'Extract Tracks' to pull pure audio files without re-compression.
steps.proTip: This is the fastest method in the world to extract podcast audio from Zoom video recordings.

steps.title: Instant 2-Second Lossless Export
steps.description: Export the finalized clips at raw file copy speeds.
actionItems: Click the green 'Export' button in the bottom right corner.
Select Output Container: 'Same as input' or MP4.
Hit 'Export' and watch the 2-second completion dialogue appear.
steps.proTip: Zero CPU fan spin, zero quality degradation, zero watermark. Pure efficiency.
